description: The file defines an Android activity named BusinessCardActivity that provides a user interface for selecting a contact, retrieving contact details asynchronously, and displaying the contact's name and phone number.

classes.name: BusinessCardActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages contact selection and displays contact details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets up the button click listener.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the contact picker and loads contact info.

methods.name: loadContactInfo
methods.description: Executes an AsyncTask to load contact information in the background.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Updates the UI with the contact's name and phone number.
